subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the candidate fixes change how explicit per-agent heartbeat configuration interacts with cron-owned scheduled wakes, which needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept cron override after full fix
options.body: Require the direct and queued wake paths plus real cron proof, then treat cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while keeping the global disable gate authoritative.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: Reject the bypass direction and require a different implementation that does not wake agents omitted from heartbeat config.

options.title: Choose one candidate PR
options.body: Pick the safest linked PR as the landing path and close or supersede the overlapping alternatives after that path is ready.

recommendation.title: Accept cron override after full fix
recommendation.body: Require the direct and queued wake paths plus real cron proof, then treat cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while keeping the global disable gate authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on per-agent heartbeat configuration semantics introduced in their history on this surface.
